research_question: Under a non-predictive portfolio process that holds one random disjoint-union18 portfolio fixed for each 50-target block and independently redraws it at each block boundary, how often does the unchanged target-1251 three-line strict gate falsely pass?
novelty_vs_E057_E058: E057 independently redrew a uniform disjoint-union18 portfolio at every target.
E058 used a per-target Markov portfolio process retaining exactly 3 of 6 numbers within each corresponding line at every transition.

E064 instead holds one independently sampled uniform ordered partition fixed for a complete non-overlapping 50-target block, then redraws the entire partition independently at the next block boundary; there is no per-target transition or forced carryover.
This is a distinct block-persistence stress mechanism for gate calibration only; it is not a predictive model or purchase-evidence axis.

null_process.initial_state: For each 50-target block, uniformly sample an 18-subset from 1..45 and uniformly partition it into three labeled six-number lines.
null_process.block_refresh: Independently generate a new uniform ordered disjoint-union18 partition at the start of every non-overlapping 50-target block; keep that exact three-line portfolio unchanged for all 50 targets in that block.
null_process.transition_between_blocks: No carryover constraint; independently redraw all 18 labels and line assignment from the same uniform ordered-partition distribution.
null_process.stationarity_argument: Every block portfolio is an independent draw from the same uniform ordered-partition distribution; the process is stationary at the block level and piecewise constant within each block.
null_process.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines with union18 at every target.
null_process.outcome_independence_rule: Portfolio generation uses only the fixed seed and PRNG. Target outcomes are read only after the block portfolio has been generated and frozen, solely to score the null trajectory.

strict_gate.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap on per-target differences from the frozen exact geometry-matched union18 null; 17 blocks sampled independently with replacement, each block start uniform over every valid contiguous 50-target start.
strict_gate.gate_rule: All four adjusted moving-block CI lower bounds must be strictly greater than zero AND at least 65% of the 17 non-overlapping 50-target any2-delta blocks must be positive (at least 12/17).

reporting.primary_endpoint: Joint false-pass rate across 1,000 block-persistent non-predictive trajectories with 95% Wilson interval.
secondary_endpoints: Per-metric empirical means versus exact uniform disjoint-union18 expectations with trajectory-level Monte Carlo standard errors.
Mean lag-1 autocorrelation of any2 outcomes.
Mean adjacent-block union and corresponding-line overlaps.
Geometry, block-constancy, source-integrity, and outcome-independence checks.
reporting.promotion_effect: None. No predictive model, candidate ranking, purchase lines, STRICT_PASS_READY, or prospective confirmation.

historical_contamination.rounds_1244_1249: Previously inspected/live-history material; not a clean holdout and not prospective confirmation.
